statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-34069 only affects the interactive Werkzeug debugger (code execution through the debugger console after an attacker obtains the debugger PIN). ReportAudit never enables that debugger: app/servicio.py line 64 starts the service with app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=..., debug=False), there is no other app.run, no use_debugger/use_reloader option and no DebuggedApplication middleware anywhere in app/ (checked with: grep -rn "debug\|DebuggedApplication" app/). The vulnerable code path is therefore never loaded. The package is still upgraded to a fixed version through the Dependabot security update (Part M.5); this statement documents why the alert was not treated as an emergency in the meantime.
